Fixes and a control CLI, plus Omarchy support.

- Notifications that replace an earlier one (volume and brightness OSDs, using
  `replaces_id` or a stack tag) now update the card in place instead of
  stacking a new one, and the progress bar animates between values (#1,
  thanks @paperbenni).
- New commands to control the running daemon: `hokum dismiss [--all]`
  closes the newest card (or all of them), `hokum invoke` clicks the newest
  card, and `hokum dnd [on|off|toggle]` sets Do not disturb; `hokum dnd`
  prints the state, `--json` prints `{"dnd":true}` and `--watch` keeps
  printing whenever it changes (#3, thanks @uncomplexity).
- The same controls are on D-Bus as methods of `app.hokum.Daemon` at
  `/app/hokum/Daemon`, with a `DoNotDisturb` property bars can watch.
- Omarchy support: Hokum reads the hints `omarchy-notification-send` sets
  (`omarchy-exec-argv` runs on click, `omarchy-actions` become buttons, and
  `omarchy-glyph` stands in for the app's letter), and
  [docs/omarchy.md](../omarchy.md) explains how to switch over and rebind
  Omarchy's notification keys (#3).
